title: AAA Character animation using AI motion capture
author: PDeperson

comments.author: furtive_turtle
comments.body: Which AI/service is being used here?

replies.author: DeProgrammer99
replies.body: It's their own product, "Human Motion Masters."

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body:
Oh, there’s a bit of a misunderstanding, we’re not developing a product. What we’re doing is building a pipeline that shows how to work with any AI motion capture tool out there to get high-quality results. It’s an agnostic approach to 3D character animation workflows.
Would you be interested in learning more about how we’re doing it?

replies.author: natandestroyer
replies.body: Not the original commentor but I would LOVE that, I'm especially interested in using your own 3d model generations, since currently they generate with really bad topology and rigs, so they are really difficult to animate, esp with motion capture.

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body:
we’re doing is building a pipeline that shows how to work with any AI motion capture tool out there to get high-quality results. Just an agnostic, flexible approach to 3D character animation workflows.

comments.author: PDeperson
comments.body:
Everyone, we’ve done our best to achieve high quality character animation results using a simple setup, just a single camera! The outcome looks promising, and we’re excited to share the motion data so anyone can inspect, learn from, and build on it. Check out the project here:
